A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ClearVQA and Ask-LLaVA study. Their complete main text, equations, Tables 1–9, Figures 1–8, and Appendices A–G support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original VQA experiments, ambiguity-discrimination results, human evaluations, and clarification-turn experiments in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the model comparisons, human assessments, real-world question evaluation, and Appendix F experiments.

M1.justification: The automatic ambiguity-clarification data pipeline, Ask-LLaVA SFT/DPO procedure, and interactive inference with yes/no feedback remain unchanged in Sections 2–3 and Appendix D.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same three ambiguity categories and coverage derived from VQAv2, OK-VQA, A-OKVQA, and ST-VQA. The separate evaluation on human-posed ambiguous VQAv2 questions is also retained.

E2.justification: Tables 1, 3, and 4 retain their comparator sets, including Stengel-Eskin et al., REPARE, GPT-4V, and GPT-4o. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: The model scales, training settings, 17,334/4,025 train/test counts, three-turn default, evaluation metrics, 100-question human assessment, and 400-question real-world evaluation are unchanged.

E4.justification: Both retain the direct-answer and image-caption controls in Table 2, clarification-turn analysis in Appendix F/Figure 6, and case studies in Appendix G/Figures 7–8. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point-estimate reporting. Neither supplies repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, or formal significance tests.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 1 retains 37.92 VQA and 47.21 EM for Ask-LLaVA-13B (SFT+DPO), while Table 5 retains its 39.67 VQA score on real-world questions.

T1.justification: Section 2.1 retains the same task definitions, interaction history in Equation 1, and answer-versus-clarification function in Equation 2. Differences in mathematical spacing do not change their content; no proofs or theoretical results are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same benchmark and automated-data contributions and the claim that training enables interactive clarification and more accurate answers. Their scientific scope and novelty claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of clarification gains, differences among ambiguity categories, and saturation after three turns remain unchanged. Both retain limitations concerning yes/no feedback, difficulty producing new clarifications after misunderstanding, and exploration limited to 7B/13B models.

D1.justification: The code/data access link, Appendix A prompts, annotation instructions, Appendix D checkpoints and hyperparameters, hardware descriptions, and Appendix E preprocessing details are unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds seven references: Wu et al. (2024, MACAROON), Guo et al. (2025, CROP), Jian et al. (2025, Look Again, Think Slowly), Ye et al. (2025a,b), and Zhang et al. (2023,2024). Guan et al. (2025, TriFine) is removed. These update citations in the introduction and Section 5 without substantial new comparative discussion.

P1.justification: The opening sentence of Section 5's Question Ambiguity paragraph is lightly rewritten around added citations, introducing the typo 'NLP filed'. The remaining narrative and section/appendix organization are essentially unchanged.

P2.justification: Added citations cause limited text reflow on the opening pages and in related work, and the bibliography occupies more of its existing pages. Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–9 retain their structures, captions, and placement.

improvement.justification: v2 primarily refreshes citations without adding substantive discussion of the newly cited work. The scientific argument, empirical evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged, including throughout the appendices. The limited wording and layout edits produce no meaningful net difference in overall quality.
